overview_hint: What is going through the server now and what went through before. Live numbers arrive as a stream; history is grouped into windows: one hour, three hours, one day, one week.
overview_chart_empty: Nothing yet: the chart will fill in as clients use the server.
overview_no_users: No users yet — create the first one on the Users page.
overview_stream_lost: The live stream was interrupted — numbers may lag behind.
users_hint: Each client gets its own account: the panel generates a password and issues an hysteria2:// link with a QR code. A disabled user cannot connect, and a deleted one loses connectivity on the next packet.
users_empty: No users yet. Create the first one to get its key right away.
users_create_placeholder: A name for the list, for example “laptop”
users_quota_gb_hint: 0 or empty means unlimited. Resetting starts the count over.
users_key_hint: Give the link to the client or show the QR code: it contains the address, password, SNI, obfuscation and certificate fingerprint.
users_copy_failed: The browser blocked copying — select the link and copy it manually
users_new_password_hint: The new password replaces the old one: the old key will stop working on the next connection. An already open client connection stays up until it reconnects.
settings_hint: Server settings: domain, response to unsolicited requests, and panel access.
settings_panel_hint: By default the panel is visible only on the server itself. To sign in from outside, forward its port over an SSH tunnel.
settings_panel_public: The panel is exposed to the internet: scanners and anyone probing addresses can see it.
settings_panel_warning: The panel will be visible to scanners and anyone probing addresses on the internet. Only the password protects it, so change the default password first.
settings_certificate_hint: The panel issues and renews the certificate itself. One certificate covers the server domain and the panel domain when they differ, so the browser shows no warning, and client keys use the same certificate.
settings_certificate_unmanaged: The panel does not manage the certificate: it was provided at startup.
settings_certificate_placeholder: Until a certificate is issued, the panel uses a self-signed one: the browser warns that it is untrusted.
settings_certificate_requested: Issuance started. The status will update when ACME responds.
settings_server_hint: The domain clients use to reach the server; it also goes into the key's SNI. The panel can live on the same domain or on a separate one — see the panel settings.
settings_server_empty: No domain set: without it the panel cannot build a client key.
settings_masquerade_hint: An unsolicited request — a scanner or a client with the wrong password — gets a decoy response, so the server looks like an ordinary website. A custom site is served from a directory on the server; a mirror proxies another site.
settings_masquerade_applied: Applied: the core was restarted and active connections were dropped.
settings_masquerade_restart: Applying restarts the Hysteria server: active client connections will be dropped.
settings_bandwidth_hint: Global server speed limits in Mbps. Zero means unlimited; the minimum non-zero limit is 0.53 Mbps. Hysteria 2 can only limit speed for the whole server; this version has no per-user limits.
settings_bandwidth_applied: Speed applied: the core was restarted and active connections were dropped.
settings_bandwidth_restart: Applying restarts the Hysteria server: active client connections will be dropped.
settings_mcp_hint: The MCP server gives AI agents read-only access to the panel. The key works separately from the administrator login and does not open /api/.
settings_mcp_restriction: The key cannot change users, the server or the certificate. Client passwords and hysteria2:// links are not exposed over MCP.
settings_mcp_created: Key “{name}” issued. Copy the token now: the panel will not show it again.
settings_mcp_token_hint: This token is the password for MCP. Keep it secret and give it only to agents you trust.
settings_mcp_copy_failed: The browser blocked copying — select the token and copy it manually
logs_hint: The latest log lines will appear here.
not_found_hint: There is no such page in the panel.
login_hint: Without signing in, the panel shows neither server status nor users.
